name: Encoder-Decoder Training
definition: Training a pair of encoder $	heta_{enc}$ and decoder $	heta_{dec}$ to reconstruct images from latent codes embedded in the RNR-Map, resembling an autoencoder but for 3D environments.
summary: Encoder-Decoder Training trains an encoder and decoder to reconstruct images from 3D latent codes, generalizing to unseen environments unlike standard NeRF optimization.
